properties.disclaimer: Static modeled rocky-intertidal habitat context, not a tide-specific waterline, surveyed boundary, navigational chart, safe route, or real-time access condition.
properties.selection_method: Original CARI Rocky Shore polygons intersecting a local-radius buffer; geometry is selected, not crop-clipped.
